sylvie: quick sync — last-mile safety net + billing harmonization before GA. TL;DR: we need final SLA language, docs update, support/runbook, monitoring alarms, and pricing publish date. who can own which? :eyes:
ajay: I can own SLA language + validation. quick proposal: SLOs + error budget. will coordinate with infra perf team.
maria: Docs owner here — I'll prepare the GA Quickstart + expectations page. need final SLO numbers by EOD Thu to write thresholds into docs.
kevin: Pricing notes: draft pricing page is up, but need reserved-capacity tiers defined and burst rules. @sara-fin any finance gating?
sara-fin: sara-fin: no blockers from finance but we need per-token cost and margin targets from infra/product to finalize list prices. pinged infra for cost per-GPU run.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout to staging scheduled: 2025-01-22 02:00 UTC (automated smoke runs attached) :rocket:
ajay: SLA draft snippet (very rough):
```
SLOs:
- Availability: 99.9% monthly (successful API responses)
- Latency: p95 < 200ms, p99 < 500ms for small generation (with caching)
- Error budget: 1% monthly
- Billing disputes SLA: respond within 48 business hours
```
maria: monitoring plan: add latency/cost dashboards, per-route error rates, and an "error budget remaining" alert. runbook: page-based oncall steps + rollback knobs. I'll draft and attach runbook skeleton.
kevin: Support & ops: I'll draft GA oncall runbook (primary product oncall, fallback infra pager, escalation matrix). also need playbook for pricing disputes / refunds.
sara-fin: finance: will review pricing tiers once per-token cost lands. can sign off on margin calc within 24h of receiving numbers.
legal-bot: legal-bot: submitted commercial terms review request (#789). expect feedback in 3 business days.
sylvie: action list (owners / due):
- Ajay: finalize SLA wording + validation tests (due Thu EOD)
- Maria: update Quickstart & "What to Expect" GA doc, add monitoring/runbook skeleton (due Fri noon)
- Kevin: finalize pricing page draft + refunds playbook, coordinate with finance (due Mon)
- Sara-Fin: confirm margin targets after infra numbers (follow-up)
- Legal: term check (tracked by legal-bot)
- Infra: provide per-token cost estimate + perf numbers (asked separately)

Please drop quick thumbs or blockers. planning a 30m sync Thu 10:00 PT to lock wording. /remind @channel review SLA draft in 48 hours :calendar:
ajay: +1. I'll put PR with SLA text and test harness up by EOD Thu.
maria: ack — will start doc PR and link here (will post PR URL).
kevin: leaning on legal for publish date, tentatively target 2025-02-03 for pricing publish. will update if legal flags.
sara-fin: noted. will prioritize margin calc once infra data lands.
sylvie: perfect — thanks all. if anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
